lines.zh: 我一步一跳，苔藓被踩出印子。
lines.en: I hop step by step, leaving prints in the moss.

lines.zh: 黑森林落叶太厚，我慢慢挪。
lines.en: The dark forest litter is thick; I shuffle along.

lines.zh: 肚子拖在地上，走路有点费劲。
lines.en: My belly drags on the ground; walking is a chore.

lines.zh: 我踩着树根，一颠一颠往前。
lines.en: I tread the roots, bobbing forward.

lines.zh: 湿泥巴正好，我的皮不会干。
lines.en: Wet mud is perfect; my skin won't dry out.

lines.zh: 我在蘑菇圈里绕了半圈。
lines.en: I circle halfway round a ring of mushrooms.

lines.zh: 四条腿轮流落地，很有节奏。
lines.en: Four legs land in turn, keeping the rhythm.

lines.zh: 我贴着倒木边走，藏住身形。
lines.en: I walk along the fallen log, keeping low.

lines.zh: 走几步，我就鼓一下喉囊。
lines.en: Every few steps I puff up my throat sac.

lines.zh: 往水边去，我的腿更有劲。
lines.en: Heading for the water, my legs feel stronger.

lines.zh: 地上太干，我专挑阴处走。
lines.en: The ground's too dry; I keep to the shade.

lines.zh: 慢慢来，跳快了容易暴露。
lines.en: Easy does it; fast hops give me away.

lines.zh: 我蹲着不动，像块湿石头。
lines.en: I squat still, like a wet stone.

lines.zh: 喉囊一鼓一瘪，我在呼吸。
lines.en: My throat sac swells and sinks; I'm breathing.

lines.zh: 有虫子飞过，我没动。
lines.en: A bug flies past; I don't move.

lines.zh: 皮肤发黏，我等着下雨。
lines.en: My skin feels tacky; I'm waiting for rain.

lines.zh: 我半闭着眼，听树叶响。
lines.en: Half-lidded, I listen to the leaves.

lines.zh: 在这林子里，耐心最好用。
lines.en: In this forest, patience works best.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等谁来踩我。
lines.en: I stay perfectly still, waiting for someone to step on me.

lines.zh: 背上落了一片叶子，我不抖。
lines.en: A leaf lands on my back; I don't shake it off.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔眼角，那里很干。
lines.en: I lick the corner of my eye where it's dry.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我数着水滴。
lines.en: When it's quiet, I count the falling drops.

lines.zh: 你站那么远，是怕我跳吗？
lines.en: Standing that far off — afraid I'll jump?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子不太灵活。
lines.en: I look up at you; my neck doesn't bend well.

lines.zh: 脚边这块泥归我。
lines.en: The mud at your feet is mine.

lines.zh: 你靴子上的泥还是湿的。
lines.en: The mud on your boots is still wet.

lines.zh: 黑森林的水坑是我的。
lines.en: The pools of the dark forest are mine.

lines.zh: 喉咙鼓起来了，别误会。
lines.en: My throat's swelling — don't take it wrong.

lines.zh: 我在估你跳多远。
lines.en: I'm judging how far you can jump.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就知道该往哪躲。
lines.en: One twitch from you and I know where to dodge.

lines.zh: 这林子归我，你只是路过。
lines.en: This forest is mine; you're only passing through.

lines.zh: 要打就打，别站着看我。
lines.en: If we fight, fight; don't just stand and stare.

lines.zh: 我皮肤一抽，黏液都抖出来了。
lines.en: My skin twitches and slime shakes loose.

lines.zh: 疼，但我还在鼓着喉咙。
lines.en: It hurts, but my throat's still puffed.

lines.zh: 我往后跳了半步，躲开。
lines.en: I hop back half a step to get clear.

lines.zh: 你打中我背上的疙瘩了。
lines.en: You hit the warts on my back.

lines.zh: 我嘴里发苦，是血的味道。
lines.en: My mouth tastes bitter — blood.

lines.zh: 这一下让我腿都发麻。
lines.en: That blow left my legs numb.

lines.zh: 我压低了身子，更难打中。
lines.en: I hunker down; harder to hit now.

lines.zh: 别以为我只会挨，我会跳。
lines.en: Don't think I only take hits; I can jump.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出的黏液黏住了土。
lines.en: Slime from the wound glues soil to me.

lines.zh: 我喘得喉咙一鼓一鼓的。
lines.en: My throat pumps as I pant.

lines.zh: 水边那点动静，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard that splash by the water.

lines.zh: 湿地方向的味道最勾人。
lines.en: The smell from the wet ground draws me most.

lines.zh: 你在往水里退？我也去。
lines.en: Backing toward the water? I'll come too.

lines.zh: 靠近点，我懒得跳远。
lines.en: Come closer; I can't be bothered to hop far.

lines.zh: 那片浅滩让我喉咙发紧。
lines.en: That shallow pool makes my throat tighten.

lines.zh: 我忍不住往前挪了半步。
lines.en: I can't help shuffling half a step forward.

lines.zh: 水声一响，我脚就痒。
lines.en: The moment water sounds, my feet itch.

lines.zh: 再湿一点，我就过去了。
lines.en: A little wetter and I'll be over there.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，我也不讨厌。
lines.en: Your body heat isn't unwelcome either.

lines.zh: 你手里那点湿东西，给我。
lines.en: That damp morsel in your hand, give it here.

lines.zh: 别踩！我的背很软。
lines.en: Don't step! My back is soft.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你鞋上全是黏液。
lines.en: Bump me and your boots are covered in slime.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来了，这是警告。
lines.en: I'm puffing up — that's a warning.

lines.zh: 你差点把我压成饼。
lines.en: You nearly flattened me.

lines.zh: 退开点，我跳起来可不管方向。
lines.en: Back off; when I jump I don't check directions.

lines.zh: 碰到我你就知道有多凉。
lines.en: Touch me and you'll know how cold I am.

lines.zh: 我滑了一下，撞到你的腿。
lines.en: I slipped and knocked into your leg.

lines.zh: 这身皮不好抓，别试了。
lines.en: This hide is hard to grip; don't try.

lines.zh: 你再挤，我就往水里跑。
lines.en: Squeeze me again and I'll bolt for the water.

lines.zh: 让让，我要过这条路。
lines.en: Make way; I need this path.

lines.zh: 浅水里等我，别在林子里。
lines.en: Wait in the shallows, not in the woods.

lines.zh: 我们鼓着喉咙对着叫。
lines.en: We puff our throats and call to each other.

lines.zh: 水边产卵，这是老规矩。
lines.en: Eggs go by the water; that's the old rule.

lines.zh: 我背上的疙瘩，你也看惯了。
lines.en: You're used to the warts on my back by now.

lines.zh: 两个影子挤在一处苔上。
lines.en: Two shadows pressed onto one patch of moss.

lines.zh: 别急，先听我叫一声。
lines.en: Not so fast; hear my call first.

lines.zh: 今晚的水很暖，正好。
lines.en: Tonight the water is warm — perfect.

lines.zh: 我笨，但我知道往哪找你。
lines.en: I'm clumsy, but I know where to find you.

lines.zh: 林子里安静，只剩我们。
lines.en: The forest is quiet; only we are left.

lines.zh: 同类的味道，我不会认错。
lines.en: I never mistake the smell of my own kind.

lines.zh: 这颗粘液球是我的了。
lines.en: This slimeball is mine now.

lines.zh: 铁粒太小，我用舌头卷起来。
lines.en: The nugget's tiny; I roll it up with my tongue.

lines.zh: 捡东西比追猎物容易。
lines.en: Picking things up is easier than chasing prey.

lines.zh: 宝盒沉，我拖着走。
lines.en: The chest is heavy; I drag it.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进落叶堆里藏好。
lines.en: I tuck it under the leaf litter to hide.

lines.zh: 这点铁，够我舔半天。
lines.en: This bit of iron will keep me licking a while.

lines.zh: 低头一吸，东西就没了。
lines.en: One dip and the thing is gone.

lines.zh: 我舌头粘住它，甩都甩不掉。
lines.en: My tongue catches it; it won't shake free.

lines.zh: 粘液球滚到我脚边了。
lines.en: The slime ball rolled right to my feet.

lines.zh: 捡到东西，我喉咙都鼓了。
lines.en: Getting loot makes my throat swell.

lines.zh: 你踩断树枝了，我听见。
lines.en: You snapped a twig; I heard it.

lines.zh: 又高又慢，你很好跳上去。
lines.en: Tall and slow — easy to jump at.

lines.zh: 我鼓着喉咙，盯上你了。
lines.en: Throat puffed, I've fixed on you.

lines.zh: 别往树后躲，我跳得过去。
lines.en: Don't hide behind the tree; I can jump that.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖，是我第一目标。
lines.en: Your knees are my first target.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进水坑了。
lines.en: Your shadow fell into my puddle.

lines.zh: 这林子太暗，你跑不远。
lines.en: The forest is too dark; you won't get far.

lines.zh: 我蹲低了，这是起跳前的样子。
lines.en: I've crouched low; this is how I jump.

lines.zh: 你好大一块，够我撞一次。
lines.en: You're a big target — enough for one good slam.

lines.zh: 瞄准了，就不改主意。
lines.en: Once I aim, I don't change my mind.

lines.zh: 湿泥地上，你的靴子会打滑。
lines.en: On wet mud, your boots will slip.

lines.zh: 我看的不是你的脸，是落点。
lines.en: I'm not watching your face; I'm watching where to land.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就找到空档。
lines.en: You turn, and I find the gap.

lines.zh: 别敲盾，那声音太吵。
lines.en: Stop banging that shield; it's far too loud.

lines.zh: 今天的苔藓味道不对，是你在。
lines.en: The moss smells wrong today — because you're here.

lines.zh: 我等了半天，就等你踩进这块地。
lines.en: I waited all along for you to step onto this ground.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚跟，一寸一寸。
lines.en: I follow your heels, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 跳一次，落地，再跳一次。
lines.en: Jump, land, jump again.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，正合我心意。
lines.en: You holding up that shield suits me fine.

lines.zh: 我在算你后退的步数。
lines.en: I'm counting how many steps you retreat.

lines.zh: 湿气帮着我，你脚步太重。
lines.en: The damp helps me; your steps are too heavy.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面，你还没发现。
lines.en: I circle to your flank and you haven't noticed.

lines.zh: 每跳一次，我就近一点。
lines.en: Every hop brings me nearer.

lines.zh: 我数着你落脚的水声。
lines.en: I count the splashes where you step.

lines.zh: 树根绊你一下，我就到了。
lines.en: One root trips you and I'm there.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，你砍不到。
lines.en: I hug the ground; your swings miss.

lines.zh: 越追越近，我快憋不住了。
lines.en: Closer and closer — I can barely hold still.

lines.zh: 你往亮处跑，我偏不进光。
lines.en: You run for the light; I won't follow into it.

lines.zh: 我在等你的盾放下。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to lower that shield.

lines.zh: 蘑菇边上，我埋伏好了。
lines.en: By the mushroom, my ambush is set.

lines.zh: 你听见咕咕声了吗？那是我。
lines.en: Hear that croaking? That's me.

lines.zh: 不远了，就差一次起跳。
lines.en: Not far now — one jump away.

lines.zh: 你踩进泥里了，很好。
lines.en: You've stepped into the mud. Good.

lines.zh: 我把你赶到倒木那边去。
lines.en: I'll drive you toward the fallen log.

lines.zh: 这一路，每一步都算过。
lines.en: Every step of this has been calculated.

lines.zh: 别回头，我已经在你右后。
lines.en: Don't look back; I'm at your right rear.

lines.zh: 我一头撞上你的膝盖！
lines.en: I slam headfirst into your knee!

lines.zh: 这一跳把你推得后退三步。
lines.en: This leap shoves you back three paces.

lines.zh: 舌头缠住你的手腕。
lines.en: My tongue wraps your wrist.

lines.zh: 牙上有毒，你会发晕。
lines.en: My teeth are venomous; you'll get dizzy.

lines.zh: 你砍我一下，我更沉了。
lines.en: You cut me once, and I only grow heavier.

lines.zh: 扑上去，压住你的脚。
lines.en: I leap and pin your foot.

lines.zh: 别舔伤口，那会更糟。
lines.en: Don't lick the wound; it'll only get worse.

lines.zh: 我撞你，你用盾挡了，也退了。
lines.en: I hit your shield, and you still slid back.

lines.zh: 湿泥一滑，我正好撞在你腰上。
lines.en: The mud slips and I ram your ribs just right.

lines.zh: 我喉咙鼓着，毒就在牙缝里。
lines.en: Throat swollen, venom sitting between my teeth.

lines.zh: 一次不够，我再来一次。
lines.en: Once isn't enough; here comes another.

lines.zh: 你腿软了吧，那是我的功劳。
lines.en: Legs going weak? That's my doing.

lines.zh: 我贴着你跳，你打不中。
lines.en: I hop right against you; you can't land a hit.

lines.zh: 这一下，粘液糊了你的眼。
lines.en: Now slime is smeared across your eyes.

lines.zh: 跳起来落下去，像块石头。
lines.en: Up I leap and down I come, like a stone.

lines.zh: 你退到水边，我就等这个。
lines.en: You've backed to the water — exactly what I wanted.

lines.zh: 水里我更快，你更慢。
lines.en: In water I'm faster, and you're slower.

lines.zh: 咬一口，我喉咙舒服多了。
lines.en: One bite and my throat feels much better.

lines.zh: 我压着你，别乱动。
lines.en: I've got you pinned; don't squirm.

lines.zh: 我这一撞顶在你胫骨上。
lines.en: This lunge lands right on your shin.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的湿土里钻出来。
lines.en: I push up out of the dark forest's wet soil.

lines.zh: 一睁眼，就是高得吓人的树。
lines.en: I open my eyes to trees that tower overhead.

lines.zh: 我在倒木底下蹲了一整夜。
lines.en: I crouched beneath a fallen log all night.

lines.zh: 苔藓被我压出一个坑。
lines.en: The moss bears a dent where I pressed it.

lines.zh: 我落进泥里，溅了一身。
lines.en: I drop into the mud and splash myself.

lines.zh: 树冠太密，这里正合我意。
lines.en: The canopy is dense — just to my liking.

lines.zh: 我鼓了一下喉咙，试着叫。
lines.en: I puff my throat and try a croak.

lines.zh: 雨还没停，我就出来了。
lines.en: The rain hasn't stopped, and here I am.

lines.zh: 这地方静得只剩我的呼吸。
lines.en: It's so quiet only my breathing remains.

lines.zh: 我趴在菌盖上，凉得很舒服。
lines.en: I sprawl on a mushroom cap; the cool feels good.

lines.zh: 从落叶堆里爬出来真费劲。
lines.en: Climbing out of the leaf pile is hard work.

lines.zh: 我记住了这片湿地的味道。
lines.en: I've memorized the smell of this wetland.

lines.zh: 火只烤干我的皮，伤不到我。
lines.en: Fire only dries my skin; it can't hurt me.

lines.zh: 摔了一下，我皮厚，没事。
lines.en: A drop, but my hide is thick — I'm fine.

lines.zh: 水里我能待很久，可这次憋太久了。
lines.en: I can stay under long, but this was too long.

lines.zh: 炸得我翻了身，肚皮朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, belly up.

lines.zh: 箭钉住我的腿，跳不动了。
lines.en: An arrow pins my leg; I can't jump.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的毒都退了。
lines.en: That light drains the venom right out of me.

lines.zh: 我饿太久，喉咙都鼓不起来。
lines.en: Too long without food; I can't even puff my throat.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整张皮都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole hide lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有泥也没有水，我只往下掉。
lines.en: No mud, no water in the void — only falling.
